## Version

Which version exhibited this failure? (e.g., v10)

## Raw idea used

```
>> [your raw idea here]
```

## Affected component

Which component produced incorrect or missing output? (e.g., C9, C5)

## Failure mode

What specifically went wrong? Be precise — "it didn't work" is not a failure mode. Name the observable symptom and what it caused.

## Expected behavior

What should the component have produced?

## Domain

What domain was the raw idea in? (ML/software, legal/compliance, clinical, creative, other)

## Additional context

Any other context that would help reproduce the issue.
